source.title: Antithrombotic Therapy for Venous Thromboembolic Disease
source.source_type: review/consensus recommendation article (Fourth ACCP Consensus Conference on Antithrombotic Therapy)

consistency_findings: Table 5 lists urokinase maintenance at 4,400 IU/kg/hour for 12 hours, whereas the adjacent narrative text states 2,200 IU/kg/hour. The discrepancy was preserved and flagged rather than silently reconciled.

The source is a review/consensus recommendation article. Quantitative trial findings are tagged secondary_reported_result and do not imply that Hyers et al. enrolled the underlying trial participants.
Formal recommendation statements can duplicate earlier narrative conclusions; they were retained as distinct source assertions because they occur in the explicit Recommendations section.
schema_gaps: No dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind exists. Formal recommendations use atom_kind=other with guideline_recommendation tags, consistent with the project secondary-source guardrail.
extraction_limitations: The PDF text layer contains occasional character substitutions and spacing artifacts; load-bearing numeric values were cross-checked against rendered pages/tables.
The bibliography begins on journal page 346S and continues through 351S; bibliography-only material was excluded from atomization.

This is not primary literature. Extraction prioritizes the article's own synthesis, recommendations, dosing/monitoring frameworks, and selected major secondary-reported quantitative results rather than atomizing every cited study result.
